[[Caz Ocean]] and [[Dox Ocean]], a pair of [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]], were given the name '''"Father Ocean"''' by the planet's native [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Akwin]].

==Description==
"Father Ocean" was the name given to the collective [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]] by the [[Akwin]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] mammals native to the planet. The two oceans into which Father Ocean was split were known as [[Caz Ocean]] and [[Dox Ocean]]. The two oceans were divided by the continent of [[Doxet]]&mdash;Caz Ocean to the west and Dox Ocean to the east&mdash;and surrounded the continents of [[Laz]], [[Elgar]], and [[Torm]] as well as both polar ice caps. The [[City-state/Legends|city-state]] of [[Doxeti]] on Doxet bordered Father Ocean's coastal waters, while the [[City/Legends|cities]] [[Dorynn]], [[Devit (city)|Devit]], and [[Lazeria City]] on Laz and [[Tormaine]] on Torm did so as well.<ref name="TSoK" />

Father Ocean was rich and abundant with life, including multiple [[Water/Legends|marine]] creatures such as [[Coral/Legends|coral]] and other small sea creatures. Both the surface-dwelling [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as [[Lazerian (people)|Lazerians]] and the Akwin used the marine life as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], with the former utilizing [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] practices. There were many aquatic [[Plant/Legends|plants]] as well. It was also rich with certain [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] that were capable of blocking [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans; because of this, the Akwin, who dwelled within Father Ocean in numerous city-states, remained largely undiscovered by the Lazerians.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Father Ocean was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
